newsitem.title: PERU: Computer failure apparently downed airliner - Peru.
newsitem.headline: Computer failure apparently downed airliner - Peru.

text.p: Peruvian Transport Minister Elsa Carrera de Escalante said a computer failure appeared to have caused the crash early Wednesday of a Boeing 757-200 which killed 70 people.
"We have listened to the recordings of the pilot," she said in a radio interview. "It seems that there was a blockage in the computer system."
Carrera added that the pilot had radioed for help before communications were cut off.
She said his final words were: "I am reducing engine power, but the plane is still accelerating."
The Peruvian navy said it had found the wreckage of the plane but not seen any sign of survivors among the 61 passengers and nine crew members aboard.
